featured_reviews.name: Akash
featured_reviews.review_text:
An apartment building located a bit ahead of the Swami Vivekanand School. From the outlook, it seems to be a newly constructed building with amenities for a modern family. There is a small nullah which passes right beside this building, so foul odour is a bit of an issue during the summers. No water leakage has been reported yet during the rains.
Has two access gates for ease of access, flats are spacious and well constructed. Guards man the security cabins and access points at all times.
